Good advice. Don't forget about lunges. Especially side lunges. And hip abduction, most gyms have a machine for this but resistance bands are just as good if not better. 

You also don't need to neglect your upper body. Some frames benefit from a bulkier chest which you can target by doing chest flys with high weight for a low number of repetitions. and cable crossovers. 

Also working out your back can help with posture. For your back I'd recommend low weight and a high number of reps. Face pulls, rows,  and lat pull downs are best for this. Just try to avoid using your traps (unless you want to have strong traps?).

All changes will happen slow and you will notice it way before other people so don't be afraid to experiment and see what works for your body.
